name: Lemnhult - Lindshammar
description: Lemnhult to Lindshammar. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official current HÖ8 is Lemnhult-Lindshammar, 16.5 km. Several route-app/tourism/PDF sources preserve older Lemnhult-Lökarydssjön or Etapp 4:5 framing around 21 km.

Smålandsleden text says the dry toilet is about 200 m from reserve parking, while coordinate-backed records put toilet/picnic/parking together and the shelter/fireplace about 200 m east along the route.
Official HÖ8 text mentions Jättabacken facilities, but HÖ8 nearby/API objects do not include them and the coordinate-backed Jättabacken cluster belongs to the HÖ7/Lemnhult boundary area.

Facilities lane found differing capacity wording, roughly 5-6 cars in Länsstyrelsen context versus lower Naturkartan wording, and the Naturkartan parking record may be older/unpublished in API context.

Trail/Naturkartan side-trail wording may use Helvets/Helvetes variants, while Länsstyrelsen uses Helvetets håla. The reserve appears near the Lemnhult endpoint but is not proven to be part of the HÖ8 main route.
Run GIS overlay to scope exactly where HÖ8 crosses Stora och Lilla Fly and whether any Helvetets håla boundary intersects the main route.
